limits: Two separate finite-growth environments; their samples are not pooled.
Performance criteria were fixed before actual; 5% is an engineering threshold, not statistical significance.
No automatic rerun; each environment ran one matrix.
Eight control requests per load cell do not estimate population tail latency.
Resource sampling can miss overshoot; child wait4 CPU excludes the observer process.
S3 work and bytes are measured, not an AWS monetary bill.
GC remained disabled; storage excludes mutable HEAD versions and worker identity.
AWS Standard, cross-AZ, steady state and production SLO remain NOT_RUN.

raw_artifacts.preservation: Original experiment runs, archives, failures, and controls are unchanged. Final repository documentation adds derived results and later CI status only.
